about: The interior rooms the builder converts by batch (--room-batches; docs/chim/DOOR_GRAPH.md "Rooms by batch in the builder"), made from the batch plan of the door graph: per room its name (the cell ID in the game data), its map name (tools/room_batches.py room_map), its save id, its order in the batch, the exterior cell its door chain starts from, the exterior cells with a load door straight into it and its door depth. Rooms with water, lava or reached only by Levitate are listed like any room; rooms set aside (lava at or under the water, over the size limit of the 32 MiB minimum machine, behaves like an exterior) and the expansions' later batches are not listed. No positions or other game data.
order: towns first (towns with rooms in the game today first, then by rooms), then the other rooms in the game, then the rest by region; inside a group by door depth
